From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Drata renewal window — cost & negotiation plan

Team,

Heads up: our Drata subscription is up for renewal in 45 days. They just sent a short notice indicating rate changes for 2027 and an upsell path for their continuous monitoring add-on. I asked for the formal renewal proposal and pricing breakdown — Emily said she would send a proposal by EOD Monday.

As next steps:
- Laura: can you run a quick usage review (who's using the control connectors, how many checks are in active use)?
- Vivek: we'll need legal to flag any contract language changes to data retention and audit rights.
- Lauren: procurement — please prep our negotiation targets (target discount % and desired onboarding credits).

Goal: avoid a full re-bid but secure a 10–15% concession + at least one complimentary month of onboarding. If Drata's moving to fixed-price bundles we should evaluate whether their new model increases unit cost.

I'll forward the proposal when it lands.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Forwarding Drata's proposal — see attached PDF and cost sheet. Quick notes: their headline renewal number is $58.4k/yr with only 5% discount baked in. Lauren — what's our negotiation target? Vivek — flagging the contract for redlines; I want to avoid open-ended retention or surprise subprocessor clauses.

Proposed internal asks to take to Emily:
- Commercial: 12% discount (to net ~51.4k/yr) or 18 months at current pricing, whichever gives better unit economics
- Onboarding: 3 months free + one dedicated onboarding engineer for the first quarter
- Legal: limit data retention to 90 days for PII indexing and explicit carveouts for audit evidence access

If we can get close to the 12% discount and the onboarding credits I think we renew without re-bid. Any objections?

Marcus

Date: 2026-08-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: RE: Drata renewal window — proposal attached

Marcus / Lauren / Laura,

I reviewed the vendor contract included as an appendix in the proposal. High-level legal items to push back on:
1) Data retention: their standard clause permits vendor retention of logs and snapshots for up to 18 months. We should limit to 90 days for any PII-derived artifacts and require explicit deletion on termination.
2) Subprocessor flow-down: require vendor to enforce equivalent protections in downstream contracts and provide a list of subprocessors with 30 days notice of changes.
3) SLA & credits: add a clear uptime SLA (99.9% target) and a credits schedule for missed SLOs.
4) Audit rights: allow Redwood a right to audit or require third-party attestations within 90 days of request.

I've attached a redline (redline_contract_v1.docx) with suggested language. If procurement can secure the 12% commercial concession our risk posture is acceptable with the above redlines.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-11T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Drata renewal — commercial & legal alignment

Emily — thanks for the proposal and for the patience while we reviewed. After internal review we are prepared to move forward on the following terms:

Commercial:
- Annual subscription at $58,400 with a negotiated 12% discount (net $51,392/yr)
- Onboarding credit: 3 months free and one dedicated onboarding engineer for the first 90 days
- Multi-year option: 2-year commitment locks current pricing; we'll circle back if you have a better uplift for 3-year.

Legal / Security:
- We will require the redline changes Vivek sent (data retention capped at 90 days for PII artifacts, subprocessor flow-down, SLA 99.9% with credit schedule, audit rights).

Please confirm acceptance of these terms and send an updated contract for signature. Prefer DocuSign; please include the updated cost breakdown and a start date consistent with our renewal window (effective 2026-09-01).

Requesting internal alignment: Laura / Lauren / Vivek — please confirm this is acceptable from your side (procurement, usage, legal) and I'll approve formally once we have the Drata doc to route to Finance for PO.

Thanks all,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
